source_en: Back from the water lines. Prayers next.
Returning to the seminary house.
Delivering donated blankets to the sector.
Opening my new bar tonight.
Back from a lucky night at the casino.
Collecting a shipment of imported caviar.
Hello, brother! A grim morning, but we're still here, aren't we?
My papers. I've been out since dawn on the water lines.
God bless your work today. Stay strong!
Then let this be my cell and my ministry both.
Whatever I carry, let it stay here, away from the others.
Carry this gently… It is a heavy thing…
Lord… receive me… I tried to do enough…
Where are you coming from?
The east district water lines since dawn, brother. Then evening prayers.
My mountain monastery. I live alone up there. I rarely come down.
Are you experiencing any symptoms?
The spirit is willing, brother. The body is only tired. Nothing more.
None. I have not left my bed in days. Rest was all I needed.
You look tired, officer. I'll mention you in my prayers tonight.
Someone has to hold the line. I'm glad it's someone like you.
